Supporting documents such as PO copy and invoice copy / challan copy / CRAC copy sh all, in this regard, be submitted by the vendors along with techno-commercial bids. Similar item(s) shall mean sand / bricks / aggregates of any type. (2) Payment Terms: Payments shall be made to the seller within 90 days for Non-MSE / 45 days for Micro and Small Enterprises (Manufacturer of quoted item) and 60 days for Medium Enterprises (Manufacturer of offered item) as per BHEL standard payment term i.e. “against receipt and acceptance of material at BHEL , Bhopal” and online submission of bills (This is in supersession of 10 days time as provided in clause 12 of GeM GTC) MSE/ MED sellers can avail the intended benefit only if they are manufacturer of offered item(s) and submi t valid MSE/MED certificate (UDYAM / NSIC etc.) along with the offer. As per Gazette Notification S.O. 3507(E) dated 30-06-2026 of Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterpri ses (MSMEs), all payments to MSME suppliers will be routed through TReDS platforms only refer Annexure A for detail. Note: Payment will be processed only after reflection of the invoice in GSTR 2A/2B. (3) Supply and unloading of material: Material shall be unloaded in four locations at its user place i.e. in Civil Maintenance Offices in Township of BHEL Bhopal through CRX (Central Receiving Store) of BHEL, Bh opal. The material shall, firstly, be brought inside factory area for weighment and then taken out for unload ing at the abovesaid locations. After unloading, the empty vehicle shall be weighed again inside the factor y area. All the related formalities shall be, duly, gone through during this whole process. The unloading & s tacking charges of the material shall be borne by the supplier himself. The measurement of the stack for quantity verification to be ensured by the supplier. Royalty receipt/docu ment are to be submitted. No detention/ haultingcharges of the transport vehicle shall be payable either to the supplier of the materi al or to the transporter, if the transport vehicle get detained/ delayed due to any reason whatsoever. It may be noted that there is 'NO ENTRY' time approx. from 6 AM to 11 PM for Heavy Transport vehicles in the area. The supplier has to arrange transport vehicles accordingly for supply of material in Township are a. (4) Quantity variation of +/-10% will be acceptable. (5) Please accept all terms and conditions of GEM bid and submit it after sign and sealed on each page as an acceptance of bid.

(6) Early delivery is acceptable. (7) Conflict of Interest as per Annexure-A is applicable for this bid. Please submit duly filled, sign & sealed Annexure-A (all pages) along with your offer. (8) Any Bidder falling under MSE category shall furnish the DECLARATION as per Annexure-A. If the bidder does not furnish the above in the tender, offer shall be processed construing that the bidder is not falling u nder MSE category. (9) Any amount on account of recovery from consigner/supplier under any condition shall be liable to be a djusted against any amount payable to the consigner/supplier against any running bills. . 7.
